name: route-card
title: Route Card
description: A trip card: a line fills behind a plane between two big codes, above a slowly turning globe of dots.

perf.budget: The globe redraws a few hundred dots on the UI thread at 30 fps while on screen, so it animates at rest. The plane only moves when progress changes.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest: the globe turns at 30 fps. An old mid-range phone; the numbers include scrolling the demo page.

a11y.reducedMotion: The globe holds still and the plane jumps to its place.
a11y.screenReader: One progress bar reading the route and times ("IST, ISTANBUL, to NRT, TOKYO. BOARDS: 09:40AM, LANDS: 03:25PM. ON SCHEDULE. KN204.") with "58% of the way".
